name: Fast Ape Frenzy
summary: Welcome to Fast Ape Frenzy! Experience the adrenaline-pumping Lava Rising Parkour, where you race against rising lava on shifting terrain, and dominate the Zero Gravity Arenas, mastering movement in anti-gravity zones. Compete with friends or players worldwide in thrilling challenges. And now, brace yourself for the brand-new Horror Mode! A spine-chilling experience filled with heart-pounding excitement, eerie surprises, and terrifying obstacles that will test your courage. Are you ready to face your fears?
